# Jyotish Tark (ज्योतिष तर्क)

> Hindi-first Vedic astrology and Hindu panchang website by astrologer Gyanendra Singh Tomar, Lucknow, India. All panchang, muhurat and Ekadashi parana times are calculated by our own engine (astronomy-engine positions, Lahiri ayanamsa, local sunrise) for each city and time zone — not copied from other sites. Content is guidance, never a guarantee.

## Panchang & muhurat
- [Aaj ka Panchang (Lucknow)](https://jyotishtark.in/panchang.html): daily tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit, Choghadiya
- [City panchang — Delhi](https://jyotishtark.in/aaj-ka-panchang-delhi.html): 26 Indian cities and 10 NRI cities (New Jersey, Chicago, Houston, Bay Area, Toronto, London, Dubai, Singapore, Sydney, Melbourne) in local time with 2027 Ekadashi dates and parana times
- [How we calculate the panchang](https://jyotishtark.in/panchang-method.html): full method, formulas and rules
- [Ekadashi list 2026–27](https://jyotishtark.in/ekadashi-list.html)
- [Festivals 2027](https://jyotishtark.in/tyohar-2027.html): Lohri, Makar Sankranti, Vasant Panchami, Mahashivratri, Holi with Lucknow muhurat
- [Festivals 2026](https://jyotishtark.in/tyohar-2026.html)

## Vrat katha & bhakti
- [Ekadashi vrat katha](https://jyotishtark.in/ekadashi-vrat-katha.html): full kathas of all 24 Ekadashis, retold in simple Hindi from the Padma / Bhavishyottara Purana
- [Satyanarayan vrat katha](https://jyotishtark.in/satyanarayan-vrat-katha.html): all five adhyay
- [Bhakti sangrah](https://jyotishtark.in/bhakti-sangrah.html): aarti, chalisa, stotra with meaning

## Rashifal & tools
- [Rashifal 2027](https://jyotishtark.in/rashifal-2027.html): yearly horoscope for all 12 rashis from real 2027 transits
- [Aapka 2027 — free personal year card](https://jyotishtark.in/mera-2027.html)
- [Free kundali](https://jyotishtark.in/kundali-form.html), [Kundali milan](https://jyotishtark.in/kundali-milan.html), [Numerology calculator](https://jyotishtark.in/numerology.html), [Mobile number numerology](https://jyotishtark.in/mobile-number-numerology.html)
